verdict.rationale: The API exposes the same independent index that powers Brave Search. It covers most search-UI functionality as documented endpoints and parameters: web, news, image, video, local/place, rich verticals, suggestions, spell check, summarization and AI answers, Goggles, date/country/safesearch filters, and search operators. However, no explicit API/UI parity guarantee is documented. Account and dashboard functions (API key creation, plan changes, billing) are only shown as browser/UI flows. Missing for 10: an explicit parity statement or feature map, API access to account/key/plan management, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (probes 404'd), and independent hands-on corroboration of parity.
